html:
G'oya

Qator takror hisoblanadi, agar xuddi shu emailli, lekin id si kichikroq boshqa qator bo'lsa. Shunday qatorlar o'chirilsa, har emaildan eng kichik id lisi qoladi.

Yechim

DELETE FROM users
WHERE EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM users u
  WHERE u.email = users.email AND u.id < users.id
)

Namunada Azizning uchta yozuvi bor: 1, 3 va 6. 3 va 6 uchun undan kichik 1 topiladi, ular o'chadi. 1 dan kichigi yo'q, u qoladi. Bekzodning emaili NULL, u.email = NULL hech qachon rost emas va uning yozuvi takror deb topilmaydi.

Tuzoqlar

Mashhur usul: har emailning eng kichik id sini topib, qolganini o'chirish. U NULL larni buzadi, chunki GROUP BY hamma NULL emaillarni bitta guruhga yig'adi va ulardan ham faqat bittasi qoladi:

Noto'g'riDELETE FROM users
WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT MIN(id) FROM users GROUP BY email)

Tuzatish uchun tashqi shartga email IS NOT NULL qo'shing. MAX(id) ni HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 bilan o'chirish ham yarim yechim: uch marta yozilgan Gulnoradan bittasi o'chadi, bittasi ortiqcha qoladi.

Boshqa yo'l

DELETE FROM users
WHERE email IS NOT NULL
  AND id NOT IN (SELECT MIN(id) FROM users GROUP BY email)

Katta jadvalda users(email) indeksi bilan ikkala yechim ham tez ishlaydi.
